analyst.summary: Lloyds Engineering Works is a heavy-engineering components maker whose order book has nearly doubled to Rs 2,643 crore, supporting strong near-term revenue visibility, alongside FY26 revenue growth of 54%. The company is still relatively early in its scaled listed history, profitability metrics (ROE/ROCE in the mid-teens) are solid but not exceptional relative to the rich ~59x valuation, and heavy-engineering order books of this size relative to current revenue typically see some execution slippage. We rate it a Hold.
